reviews.comment:
I was introduced to David at Insider Mortgage by our realtor when we first purchased a home in San Diego. Since then, we've refinanced three different times with them, and it's been a positive experience every time. The guys work around the clock and are convenient, working with my strange schedule to make sure everything happens when it needs to. They're reachable by phone or email, and they seem to be trustworthy and solid guys.

What stands out is their approachability and how thorough they are with their spreadsheets and numbers, really doing the math for you and breaking down what financially makes sense. They walked me through the refinancing process and properly explained it so I always knew what was going on. They're very easy to get a hold of, which is important. If I decide to buy or refinance again in the future, David would definitely be the person I'd call or recommend to others.

I was referred to Rakesh when I was selling my townhome and moving into a new home in the San Diego area. What I appreciated was that he never came to me with just one answer. He would lay out different loan options, explain them, and let me decide which direction made the most sense. There was a lot of transparency throughout the process, and I always felt like I understood the choices in front of me.

What ended up being just as valuable happened after I bought the house. I wasn't even aware of some of the refinance opportunities that were available as rates changed, but Rakesh and his team at Insider Mortgage were paying attention. Every so often they would reach out, explain what was happening with rates, and give me different options to consider. Many of those options were things I would not have known to look for on my own. They would present different choices, explain them clearly, and let me decide what made the most sense. I've already referred several people from my network, and at least a couple of them are actively working with him now. I super strongly recommend Rakesh and his team. If you're looking at mortgage loans, they should absolutely be one of your first calls.

Rakesh is amazing. My husband and I have been working with ​Insider Mortgage for about 10 years now, since we bought our first home in 2015, and we’ve done about five or six transactions with ​Rakesh since, including buying our first home, refinancing, a HELOC, and now purchasing a bigger home in Chula Vista. We’ve trusted him from day one because he always finds us great rates and explains everything so clearly. He’s also very honest. Even though we qualified for a lot more on this last home, he actually recommended staying in a lower price range because he was thinking about what would be comfortable for us, not just what we could get approved for.

He’s also incredibly responsive, answers calls, emails, and questions quickly, and has always been accommodating with our schedule. My husband and I both work and have kids, so he’s taken meetings with us as late as 7pm after dinner. Really professional, really kind, and he’s made every step of the process smooth. I recommend him 1,000%.

If anyone doesn't hire Rakesh as their mortgage broker, that's honestly their loss. He's family to me at this point, and I've used him for four transactions now. He's incredibly efficient, always on top of things, and he genuinely takes the time to explain the logic behind the mortgage so you actually understand your options, the best loan rates, and the pros and cons of each scenario. His depth of knowledge is honestly unmatched. You ask him anything, and he gives you the full picture and points you in the right direction.

I've referred Rakesh to people in my business and in my friend circle, and every single one of them has had a great experience too. If you're looking for a mortgage broker in Northern California, he's the person I'd send you to because you'll actually understand what you're getting into before you commit to anything.

I work at a fire station, and a handful of guys here have used David at Insider Mortgage, so when I knew I was going to be refinancing after some renovations, I figured why not give it a whirl. Really glad I did because David made it easy. Everything he needed was clearly laid out, so I was never guessing at what came next. The whole process was simple, straightforward, and easy to understand.

What sets Insider Mortgage apart is how creative and customizable the approach is. David sent over really detailed videos explaining options, rates, and the reasoning behind what he does. It's not your standard lender experience. He tailors things to your specific goals and what you actually need, which, when you think about the concept of what he does, it's pretty different from what most lenders put in front of you. I'd 100% use him again for my next refinance in Vista and would recommend him to anyone looking to get more out of their loan.
